title: Elevated Error Rates on Token Verification (/oauth/token)

updates.body: We are currently investigating elevated HTTP 503 error rates and token exchange timeouts impacting customers in US-East.
The issue has been identified as a deadlocked connection pool within the upstream cryptographic signing broker. Remediation traffic rerouting is underway.
Mitigation deployed. Core identity services are recovering with error rates subsiding below 0.2%.
All identity services and /oauth/token endpoints have returned to fully operational status.
